subject: multipleGroup requires a lot of memory

messages.author: a8144d65f36aaf6a
messages.subject: multipleGroup requires a lot of memory
parts:
Hi,

I am fitting multidimensional graded models with different factor structures to a Likert scale dataset of ~200 individuals taking the same test ~70 times and want to assess which model fits better.

In order to account for within-person dependence, I am treating each individual as a "group" and each measurement becomes an independent "person". First I tried fitting mirt to models separately. Since in some groups some items had no scores (i.e. all response were zero) I got this error:
Error: The following items have only one response category and cannot be estimated: Angry, Anxious.

Phil Chalmers suggested using multipleGroup instead. However, I got a similar issue to this as posted on in 2016 on this Google group--the same groups causing the unidentifiability problem in my previous attempt of fitting simple models to the groups separately.

Now that I pass invariance = c('free_means','free_var','slopes') argument to multipleGroup function, I get this error:
Error: cannot allocate vector of size 26.0 Gb
Why is this happening? What can I do to solve it?

Thanks in advance,
MH Manuel Haqiqatkhah.
